sections.heading: Choosing the Right Glass for Your Commercial Replacement Project
sections.body: Selecting the appropriate glazing product is one of the most important decisions in any commercial window replacement project. The right choice depends on factors including your building's orientation, your existing frame system, local climate conditions, aesthetic goals, and occupant comfort requirements. Common options for commercial applications include dual-pane insulated glass units, which provide improved thermal separation compared to single-pane alternatives, as well as low-emissivity coatings that help manage solar heat gain. Laminated glass is often specified in areas where safety and security are priorities, such as ground-floor storefronts or high-traffic entry points. Tempered glass is standard in many commercial applications due to its strength and breakage characteristics. Our team will walk you through the available options during the assessment phase, explaining the practical tradeoffs of each so you can make a well-informed decision that fits your building's needs and your capital budget. We source quality materials and stand behind our installation work.
